description: US-27 The portion allowance is removed. DF used the counter during the testing phase and reported that the portion figure describes nothing that happens at their distribution: food is not handed out in portions, a staff member decides per distribution HOW MUCH food each grown-up and each child gets, and that varies with what was donated that week. The number is not wrong and does not need correcting — THE QUANTITY IT NAMES DOES NOT EXIST. So this batch is a deletion: the derivation (src/domain/policy/portions.ts), the two settings (portionsPerGrownUp, portionsPerChild), the two schema columns, five displays (counter, customer record, live household editor, card view, customer list), the German strings, the tests and the documents. THE PRICE IS UNTOUCHED — still per head, still capped by the Maximalpreis, still derived through priceFor. The counts are untouched. SCHEMA CHANGE: SettingsVersion loses two columns; migration history is REGENERATED, not stacked on, and the hand-written partial unique index on Customer.customerNumber must be re-added. NO new port method, no application logic change beyond dropping one derived field. THE STORY ORDER IS DELIBERATELY THE INVERSE OF THE USUAL LAYERED BUILD: a deletion works outside-in, because each step must leave a compiling tree. Screens stop READING the figure first, then the seam stops deriving it, then the settings leave the domain and the form, then the columns leave the schema. Built inside-out the first story would break every call site at once. The failure mode of this batch is a SURVIVOR — one Stat, one dictionary key, one comment that keeps a deleted concept alive — so US-005 makes `grep -ri portion src/ tests/ prisma/` returning nothing an acceptance criterion. Source: tasks/prd-us-27-remove-portion-allowance.md

Every remaining doc comment that names the portion allowance as a motivation is reworded to name the price alone: the headers of settings.ts, householdComposition.ts, src/domain/calendarDay.ts, src/domain/card/staleCard.ts, src/domain/customer/customer.ts and src/domain/errors.ts. userStories.notes: Landed as one compile unit: Settings, SETTINGS_FIELDS, SettingsChange, the exhaustive switch, FullValues, the form's two NumberFields, the server action, the dictionary, the seed and the repository.
